Signa includes adapted signing-engine modules from three.ws by nirholas and
contributors, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws
Modifications: G/H wrist orientations in fingerspelling.js; model-specific
finger calibration, cached pose interpolation and thumb contact solving in
custom Signa modules.

The avatar is adapted from Microsoft Rocketbox Female_Adult_01.
https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox
Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft. MIT License: rocket/LICENSE.md.
Adaptations: canonical bone names, fingertip markers, indexed and grouped
geometry, selective skin-aware hand refinement, WebP textures, GLB conversion.
No motion-capture or linguistic-validation claim is made.

Three.js 0.170.0, GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils are bundled locally.
See three/LICENSE and source headers for license notices.
